'''Checkers''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He initially served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in [[Laser Company]] before the [[Company/Legends|unit]] was [[Kessel encounter|depleted]] all except for him at [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Although he bore no ill will toward Fisto, Checkers requested to be transferred to [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] when he was rewarded with the opportunity for being the unit's only clone survivor of the encounter. He fought in a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].
